FAQs

Frequently Asked Questions

A real dispatcher is available if your question is not answered here.

Call (888) 842-2618 →

Start with the problem you are seeing: scratching in the attic points to attic rodent removal, droppings in the kitchen to kitchen rodent control, and a smell you cannot locate to dead rodent removal. If you are not sure, book a rodent inspection and we will identify the species, the entry points and the right fix.

Call (888) 842-2618 any time — our emergency line runs 24/7 — or use the contact page. Dispatch will recommend the right starting service, schedule your visit and confirm your flat-rate written quote before work begins.

Both are linked from this sitemap and from the footer of every page: the Terms of Service explain our flat-rate quotes, guarantee and scheduling, and the Privacy Policy explains what information we collect and how we use it.
